blessings.arabic: الحمد لله رب العالمين
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has fed us and given us drink

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في بدني
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has granted me health in my body

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا الثوب
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي آواني
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me shelter

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي هداني للإسلام
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has guided me to Islam

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي علمني ما لم أكن أعلم
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has taught me what I did not know
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee allamanee ma lam akun a'lam

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي بنعمته تتم الصالحات
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah, by whose grace good deeds are completed
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee bi ni'matihi tatimmu as-salihat

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أحياني بعد ما أماتني
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me life after death (sleep)
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ahyanee ba'da ma amatanee

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي رزقني الأهل والولد
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with family and children

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي عينين أبصر بهما
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me eyes with which to see
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee aynayn ubsiru bihima

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي أذنين أسمع بهما
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me ears with which to hear
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee uthunayn asma'u bihima

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي لساناً أنطق به
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me a tongue with which to speak
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee lisanan antiqu bihi

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي سخر لنا هذا
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has made this subservient to us

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أنزل من السماء ماءً
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who sends down water from the sky
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee anzala min as-sama'i ma'an

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أنبت لنا الزرع
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who causes crops to grow for us

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل الشمس ضياءً
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who made the sun a source of light

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل القمر نوراً
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who made the moon a source of light

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي خلق الليل والنهار
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who created the night and the day

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لنا النوم سباتاً
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who made sleep a rest for us
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lana an-nawma subatan

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي شفاني من مرضي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has healed me from my illness

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أذهب عني الهم والحزن
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has removed worry and sadness from me
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee athhaba annee al-hamma wal-huzn

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي فرج عني الكرب
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has relieved me from distress

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي رزقني من الطيبات
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has provided me with good things

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعلني من المسلمين
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has made me among the Muslims

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي وفقني لطاعته
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has enabled me to obey Him

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي بارك لي في رزقي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed my sustenance
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee baraka lee fee rizqee

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أعطاني القوة
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me strength

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي حفظني من الشر
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has protected me from evil

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي أصدقاء صالحين
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me righteous friends
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee asdiqa'a saliheen

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي يسر لي أموري
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has made my affairs easy

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أنعم علي بالصحة
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with health

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي رزقني العقل
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with intellect

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي قلباً يخشاه
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me a heart that fears Him
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee qalban yakhshahu

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي ستر عيوبي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has concealed my faults

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي غفر لي ذنوبي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has forgiven my sins

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي رزقني الصبر
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with patience

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أنعم علي بالأمن
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with security

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي عملاً أتكسب منه
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me work to earn from
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee amalan atakaasabu minhu

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي بارك لي في وقتي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed my time
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee baraka lee fee waqtee

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي مكاناً آمناً
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me a safe place
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee makanan aminan

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أطال في عمري
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has extended my life

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعلني أمشي على قدمي
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who enables me to walk on my feet
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'alanee amshee ala qadamayya

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي يدين أعمل بهما
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me hands to work with
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee yadayn a'malu bihima

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي نجاني من البلاء
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has saved me from trials

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أعانني على ذكره
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has helped me remember Him

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي قلباً يحبه
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me a heart that loves Him
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee qalban yuhibbuhu

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي رزقني التوبة
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with repentance

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله الذي جعل لي نعماً لا تحصى
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah who has given me countless blessings
blessings.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi allathee ja'ala lee ni'aman la tuhsa

blessings.arabic: الحمد لله على كل حال
blessings.english: Praise be to Allah in all circumstances
